#| cache: true
```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot

# Filter to the three main storm types and count unique storms per year and type
storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Atlantic Storms per Year by Type",
    subtitle = "Source: NOAA Atlantic hurricane database (dplyr::storms)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Observations by storm status

```{r}
#| label: storms-by-status

storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: pressure-vs-wind

# Plot pressure vs. wind colored by storm status, with alpha for overlapping points
storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Higher Wind Speeds Correspond to Lower Air Pressure in Atlantic Storms",
    subtitle = "Storm observations from 2000 to present, colored by storm classification",
    x = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Air Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
